[SWS_DM_01081] Session check for sourceDataIdentifier
⌈
On re-
ception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunctiondefineByIdenti-
fier and if DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.checkPer-
SourceId is set to true, the DM shall check if the sourceDataIdentifier can be defined
in the current session according to [SWS_DM_00413]. If the DDID cannot be defined
in the current session, the DM shall return an NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange).
⌋
